label: PHASE 4B coach pricing and joint team+coach optimum
target_account_state: state 5: Core Xtreme Gaming, Mid Team Yandex, Support Xtreme Gaming, 38 tokens

sources: operator's live client Coaching Titles panel
prefix_and_suffix_definitions.finding: All 8 prefixes and all 8 suffixes match the client panel exactly, including every bonus percentage. titles.ts also carries a Russian translation of each condition, which is an independent restatement rather than a copy of the English.
prefix_and_suffix_definitions.not_tier_1: None of this is a Valve source; it is corroboration.

third_party_score_model_rejected.finding: Kadadji's lib/optimizer.ts composes traits MULTIPLICATIVELY (factors[i] *= 1.6 for Fractal, *= 1.3 Unique, *= 1.5 Friendly/Vampiric, *= 1.2 / *= 0.9 for adjacency).
third_party_score_model_rejected.why_rejected: That is the rule this project used before the client falsified it. On the target account's own Core banner it would give quality x 1.2 rather than 1 + 0.60 + 0.20, and it reproduces none of the 18 observed multipliers. Their definitions are usable evidence; their scoring model is not.
third_party_score_model_rejected.our_rule: multiplier = 1 + quality_bonus + net_trait_bonus, validated on 18 emblems across two accounts plus two predictions made before the fact.

strict_subset_only: Elemental: isaquatic is a subset of 'aquatic, fiery or ice'
Otherworldly: isundead is a subset of 'undead, demon or spirit'

hero_category_table.consequence: Our own hero_id recomputation can verify three prefixes exactly and only LOWER-BOUND the recommended one. That limit is stated rather than papered over.

denominator_reconstruction.question: Are Kadadji's prefix values counts or percentages?
denominator_reconstruction.evidence: The repo's own accessor names the field `frequency`, and getAveragePrefixFrequency takes a plain arithmetic mean of the two players in a pair. No denominator, match count or normalisation appears anywhere in the repository.
denominator_reconstruction.range_check: All values lie in 0..62, and per-player totals across the eight categories run 142..198. Both readings fit that: percentages can exceed 100 in total because a hero can belong to several categories, and counts over roughly 100-150 matches give the same range.
denominator_reconstruction.resolution: Not resolvable from the source, so BOTH readings were carried and compared. Reading A treats them as percentages; reading B treats them as counts and normalises each player by his own total, which is the proxy for unequal denominators. The two readings agree on the ranking, because the per-player totals are similar enough that normalising does not reorder the prefixes.
denominator_reconstruction.status: UNRESOLVED as a fact, IRRELEVANT to the decision

prefix_pricing.method: expected gain = sum over roles of role_score x bonus x trigger_frequency, with the role frequency taken as the mean over that role's players
prefix_pricing.averaging_caveat: The exact rule is a score-weighted mean of the two players' triggers, since the role score is the mean of individual scores. An arithmetic mean of the frequencies is used because per-player scores are not separated in this pipeline; with bonuses of 6-11 percent the difference is second order.
prefix_pricing.agreement: Elemental first and Royal second under both. Heroic, the title currently equipped, is fourth or fifth.
prefix_pricing.decision_status: ROBUST across the two admissible readings

suffix_pricing.why_frequency_times_bonus_is_the_wrong_r: A period keeps the MAXIMUM over series, so what matters is the correlation between a trigger and the game's score, not the naive product. the Underdog fires on 45.7 percent of player-maps but only on LOSSES, which are low-scoring games the maximum discards: it delivers 1.29 percent against a naive 2.74 percent. the Lucky fires on a duration digit, which is independent of performance, so the maximum picks it up: it delivers 3.14 percent against a naive 1.56 percent.

unpriced_rivals.honest_caveat: the Tormented is uncorrelated with the fantasy player's own performance, so it would amplify like the Lucky and its effective breakpoint is lower than 13.7 percent. It is a live candidate that cannot be priced here.

joint_team_and_coach.structure: total = sum over roles of f(team; prefix, suffix), separable GIVEN the coach, so the exact optimum is a search over coach settings with a per-role argmax inside
joint_team_and_coach.result: Under ALL EIGHT prefixes the per-role argmax is the same triple: Xtreme Gaming / Team Yandex / LGD Gaming. The coach-team coupling is real in principle and does not move a single team choice in fact.
joint_team_and_coach.gap_source: entirely the Support slot, which is blocked by the unscoreable Watchers emblem
